note: Phelps County publishes its zoning resolution as text PDF and its zoning map is kept by the zoning administrator with no download or service. The county's gWorks host (Phelps_County_NE_Assessor) has roads, parcels and sections only, with no zoning field. Holdrege, the largest city, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF. The ArcGIS search found no Phelps or Holdrege zoning service. A services.arcgis.com 'zoning_districts' layer labelled for this county is actually Mesa, Arizona data with no features in the county.
